_note: Missions on the real terrain near the spawn (coordinates in world metres, x east, z south; heading in compass degrees). Crests found with a local-maximum search over the DEM (see DECISIONS W6.5).

missions.title: Free roam
missions.desc: Drive anywhere in the 20 km of Ramlat Al Wahiba. Credits for every kilometre off-road.

missions.title: Time attack: west dune
missions.desc: Climb 22 m to the crest west of the corridor.

missions.title: Time attack: big east face
missions.desc: 38 m of climb in 215 m. Air down and use 4H.

missions.title: Recovery: stuck tourist
missions.desc: A tourist wagon is beached west of the corridor. Drive there, hook up a strap (T) and snatch it out.

missions.title: Convoy route to the camp
missions.desc: Lead the convoy over the western dunes to the camp. Stay on the route: four checkpoints.
